# Culture and gestures: measuring negative transfer in Manager

2026-11-26 / preliminary research. MC-SIGNS (ACL 2025) studies context-dependent interpretations of gestures. We use its CC BY4.0 CSV at pinned revision 3186e4d082047fe50d23010ce4681803872f19a7 in a new binary aggregate text-only adaptation, not the authors' official protocol. Of 1,408 ratings, 225 unsure/free-response excluded; 281 scored pairs, 84 countries, 25 gestures, 268 non-tied. Actual 1,124 forwards, base SmolLM2 and existing UCI-trained Pilot005, both answer orders. Equal-pair MSE base .179841, pilot .191089, leave-country-out gesture prior .148215. Soft NLL .693742/.716325/.704022. Majority accuracy .466418/.339552/.660448. Prior uses labels from other countries; different information regimes, descriptive only. No training, no causal claim, not individual prediction, no new spend. Country does not define any individual. Source https://github.com/Akhila-Yerukola/culturally-offensive-gestures ; paper https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.1218/ .
